question: Should outbound recovery keep ambiguous entries pending with backoff when no reconciliation-capable adapter is available, instead of moving them to failed?
rationale: The pacing defect is mechanically repairable, but pending-versus-failed ambiguous rows are an operator and upgrade behavior choice that tests cannot settle.

options.title: Accept Recoverable Pending
options.body: Merge after the no-op pacing defect is repaired and exact-head validation is green if maintainers want future recoverability over terminal failed rows.

options.title: Keep Fail-Closed State
options.body: Pause or close this PR if maintainers prefer terminal failed rows until the full delivery ledger design is ready.

options.title: Require Operator Surface First
options.body: Require a doctor, API, or UI surface for deferred ambiguous rows before changing queue terminalization.

recommendation.title: Accept Recoverable Pending
recommendation.body: Merge after the no-op pacing defect is repaired and exact-head validation is green if maintainers want future recoverability over terminal failed rows.
